scenes.basis: 11:2 "When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him" - Joppa and Caesarea in Peter's retelling are mentions
11:20 "when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus"; 11:26 "The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch"
11:27 "prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch" - Agabus stands and the relief is collected in the Antioch assembly
